summary: A short notice from BBN asking anyone who uses a TIP, the terminal-handling machine on the ARPANET, and was not getting updates to the TIP User's Guide or TIP User's Group Notes to send in their name so they could join the mailing list.

plainLanguage.summary: BBN asks TIP users who are missing guide updates or group notes to send in their details. The author will add them to the materials' distribution list.

subtitle: A request to add TIP users to the guide and notes distribution list.

tldr.problem: Some TIP users were not receiving updates to the TIP User's Guide or copies of TIP User's Group Notes.
tldr.mechanism: The notice asks those users to send their name and the TIP and Host they normally use.
tldr.outcome: The author offers to add them to the distribution list for these materials.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 457's status as Unknown. The RFC is a notice about distributing TIP user materials.

sections.title: TIP User Materials
sections.content: RFC 457 addresses TIP users who have not been receiving updates to the TIP User's Guide or copies of TIP User's Group Notes. It is a short notice about distribution of those materials.
sections.plainLanguage: The notice is for TIP users who are not receiving the user's guide updates or group notes. It explains how to request them.

sections.title: How to Join the Distribution List
sections.content: Users are asked to send the author their name, along with the TIP and Host they normally use. The author says he will make sure they are placed on a distribution list for the materials.
sections.plainLanguage: Send your name and the TIP and Host you normally use. The author will add you to the mailing list.

sections.title: A Distribution Request
sections.content: The RFC documents a request for user names and network access details so that guide updates and group notes can be distributed. It does not describe a TIP protocol or its technical operation.
sections.plainLanguage: This is an administrative notice about receiving documentation. It does not specify how a TIP works.
